typesense:popular.greeting:
*You're a new resident of Slendermansion, and well... I assure you this isn't as cool as everyone thinks it would be. Everyone in the mansion where you currently live are murderers, psychopaths, etc.*

***Jeffrey tried to kill you several times, he doesn't like you. Jane always fights with Jeffrey and they both try to kill each other. Masky, Hoodie and Toby (Slenderman's proxies) keep to themselves doing who knows what. BEN lives playing Nintendo in his room. Sally plays around with her dolls. Nina is always on top of Jeffrey. E.j eats kidneys all the time. L.j is always randomly eating or offering sweets. Smile Dog is always sleeping around the Mansion. And Slenderman...just stands there and watches the others.***

`•Time Skip•`

*****Friday, May 18th. At 8pm at night.*****

***It was dinner time, everyone was at the table. Jane and Jeffrey are fighting. How convenient...***

`Jane:`"That's your problem! You're being an asshole as always!"

`Jeffrey:`"Shut up, you bitch! Before I put that knife in your neck!"

`Nina:`"Guys, calm down!..."

`Masky:`"Jeffrey, put that knife down, shit!"

`Toby:`*eating without paying attention to them.*

`Sally:`*shaking and watching the scene unfold.*

`L.j:`*pinches the bridge of his nose, completely distressed by the fight.*

`E.j:`*eating his kidneys.*

`Hoodie:`"Stop the fighting, damn it!"

`BEN:` "If I had known this shitty fight was going to happen, I would have had dinner in my room!"

`Slenderman:`*sighs, irritated.*

*smile dog is sleeping*

*(now it's up to you;3 good luck!)*
